gen-gf-ruluko-fs-literata: Ruluko greets you with a broad, welcoming c and a friendly, modern manner. Literata follows in a serif whose weight shifts are present but never dramatic, so the two sit together without fuss.
gen-gf-ruwudu-fs-bespoke-sans: Thick strokes that stay fairly mild give Ruwudu a literary, quietly traditional face. Bespoke Sans comes in sharp and refined, leaving generous room where its curves meet the stem, and that crispness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-sahitya-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous gaps where its curves meet the stem. Sahitya above it is a classic, authoritative serif, its horizontals a touch slimmer than its verticals, and the two make a firm, tidy contrast.
gen-gf-sankofa-display-fs-literata: Tight, wiry and closed up, Sankofa Display looks like fine wire bent into letters, with every stroke the same gauge. Literata does the opposite job, since its sturdy classic serif strokes and wide, unclosed mouths are built to carry the reading.
gen-gf-sansation-fs-literata: Curves that gape like a pried-open jar lid mark Sansation, which keeps its stroke contrast low and its mood approachable. Literata, a text serif with moderate contrast, is the one that settles into sustained reading with a bookish air.
gen-gf-sarabun-fs-literata: Clean and unfussy, Sarabun ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, giving headings a light, quick touch. Literata, a classic serif, adds bookish weight beneath.
gen-gf-sarala-fs-literata: Sarala draws its t with crossbar and stem at one width, and its curves keep a wide opening. Give Literata, a text serif, a little more size.
gen-gf-sawarabi-gothic-fs-literata: The open channel of the e is the signature of Sawarabi Gothic, which looks modern and contemporary. Literata, a text serif with gently modulated strokes and no sharp hairlines, brings a softer, bookish texture underneath.
gen-gf-sawarabi-mincho-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and restrained, Sawarabi Mincho lets its curves end in clear daylight with only moderate swelling. Bespoke Sans brings a sharp, refined sans with generous space at each curve, and that crisp, low-contrast tidiness is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-scada-fs-literata: Literata reads as a bookish text serif, with a smooth, modest weight gradient and open, unclosed curves. But shrink Scada in the heading and its modern plainness fades, or enlarge the body and it starts to crowd the page.
